newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish prison worker shot in apparent ETA attack.
newsitem.headline: Spanish prison worker shot in apparent ETA attack.

text.p: A Spanish prison psychologist was shot three times in the head in the Basque city of San Sebastian on Tuesday, police said.

The wounded man, Javier Garcia Elosegui, 37, was taken to hospital after the 8.15 a.m. (0715 GMT) attack, which state radio said appeared to have been carried out by ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) Basque separatist rebels.
Garcia Elosegui later died in hospital, police said.

ETA, which has killed some 800 people since starting an independence drive in 1968, kidnapped another prison worker more than a year ago and has been holding him to try to pressure the government into changing its prison policy.
Police said they had detained one of the two alleged attackers. Witnesses said two hooded people fled the scene in the centre of the city after the attack.
ETA has stepped up its violent activity since the start of the year, killing six people including a Supreme Court judge.
